example.title: Huntington Beach Municipal Pier end (octagonal T-head, 1992)

brief: The seaward end of the rebuilt concrete pier: a broad octagonal concrete deck on slender concrete pile bents, white pipe rails and iron lamp standards all round, benches, and the red-roofed diner in the middle. Three photos. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
